comment: The repeated AI content thing is probably going to get worse because platforms reward whatever keeps people scrolling, not necessarily whatever is interesting. The weird part is that even before AI, a lot of online spaces were already drifting toward recycled jokes and outrage bait. AI just made the factory cheaper and faster. I wonder if people will eventually start valuing smaller communities more because they feel less like a content landfill.
